title: The Founding Business mark is a quiet frosted pill with a small sparkle, and no Space accent can recolor it
detail: Daniel 2026-10-19 (screenshot of House of Fates: the badge was solid purple) and 2026-10-20 ('Don't make those founding business badges so wild. Keep it a classy thing. More of a sparkle than a lightning bolt'). A Space's chosen accent (SCAN-979) re-binds --fq-pa on the page, and the mark read --fq-pa, so it took the Space's color. The mark (FounderMark, on the Space cover and the Spaces directory card) is now a frosted pill with ink type and a small four-point sparkle in place of the gem, normal case, no glow, and it reads no accent or pastel token at all, so every Space shows the same mark. The Space's own accent still colors its buttons, active tab and in-body highlights by design. No migration. In the Spaces directory the mark shows on the Featured Spaces cards but not on every card under the Founding Businesses heading, which already says it (Daniel 2026-10-20, screenshot of /spaces/directory).

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const bad=[];const c=fs.readFileSync('app/themes/frequency/space-page.css','utf8');const m=c.match(/\\.fq-founder\\{[^}]*\\}/);const f=fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/members/space/founder-mark.tsx','utf8');if(!m)bad.push('no .fq-founder rule');else if(/--fq-pa|--space-accent/.test(m[0]))bad.push('Founding mark reads an accent or pastel token');if(/Gem|Zap/.test(f))bad.push('Founding mark is a gem or bolt again');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1110: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the Founding mark reads a Space accent or the pastel fill, or goes back to a gem or bolt icon.
